SV_FastSlow_Buckets.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT 
    "Material",
    "Plant",
    MAX("PostingDate") AS "Latest_Posting_Date_Overall",
    MONTH(MAX("PostingDate")) AS "Latest_Posting_Month",
    MIN("PostingDate") AS "First_Posting_Date",
    SUM("QuantityInBaseUnit") AS "Total_Outward_Quantity",
    COUNT("Material") AS "Total_Movement_Count",
    
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX("PostingDate"), TO_DATE('19000101', 'YYYYMMDD')), 
        MIN("PostingDate")
    ) AS "Effective_Last_Movement_Date",
    
    DAYS_BETWEEN(
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(MAX("PostingDate"), TO_DATE('19000101', 'YYYYMMDD')), 
            MIN("PostingDate")
        ), 
        :P_KEYDATE
    ) AS "Days_Since_Last_Movement",
    
    -- THE FIX: Raw calculation inside CASE, wrapped in CAST to force decimal output
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX("PostingDate"), TO_DATE('19000101','YYYYMMDD')), MIN("PostingDate")), :P_KEYDATE) <= 30 
        THEN SUM("QuantityInBaseUnit") ELSE 0 END 
    AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS "Fast_Moving_0_30",
    
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX("PostingDate"), TO_DATE('19000101','YYYYMMDD')), MIN("PostingDate")), :P_KEYDATE) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 
        THEN SUM("QuantityInBaseUnit") ELSE 0 END 
    AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS "Slow_Moving_1_31_60",
    
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX("PostingDate"), TO_DATE('19000101','YYYYMMDD')), MIN("PostingDate")), :P_KEYDATE) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 
        THEN SUM("QuantityInBaseUnit") ELSE 0 END 
    AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS "Slow_Moving_2_61_90",
    
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX("PostingDate"), TO_DATE('19000101','YYYYMMDD')), MIN("PostingDate")), :P_KEYDATE) BETWEEN 91 AND 180 
        THEN SUM("QuantityInBaseUnit") ELSE 0 END 
    AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS "Slow_Moving_3_91_180",
    
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX("PostingDate"), TO_DATE('19000101','YYYYMMDD')), MIN("PostingDate")), :P_KEYDATE) > 180 
        THEN SUM("QuantityInBaseUnit") ELSE 0 END 
    AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS "Dead_Greater_180"

FROM "GV_FastSlow_Base"
WHERE "PostingDate" <= :P_KEYDATE
GROUP BY 
    "Material", 
    "Plant"
